build_circular_geometry: build a circular geometry provider using pydantic_model.Geometry.from_dict with geometry_type circular and n_rho
build_chease_geometry: build a chease geometry provider using pydantic_model.Geometry.from_dict with geometry_type chease and n_rho
build_time_dependent_chease_geometry: build a time-dependent chease geometry provider using pydantic_model.Geometry.from_dict with geometry_configs mapping time to config
test_geometry_validation: test that pydantic_model.Geometry.from_dict raises ValueError when geometry_type is missing
test_rmin_rmax_ordering: test chease.CheaseConfig and circular_geometry.CircularConfig reject invalid R_major and a_minor values
